help.topics.how-it-works.summary: Scan, browse, and check out on your phone.
help.topics.scan-qr.title: Scanning a QR code
help.topics.scan-qr.summary: Open your camera or tap a link to reach a shop menu.
help.topics.scan-qr.body1: Find the Zintriq QR code at the checkout counter, on a table tent, or on a product tag.
help.topics.scan-qr.body2: Point your phone camera at the code — most phones open the link automatically.
help.topics.scan-qr.body3: You land on that store's menu. No app download required.
help.topics.cart-checkout.title: Cart & checkout
help.topics.cart-checkout.summary: Add items and pay when the shop has payments enabled.
help.topics.cart-checkout.body1: Items must have Allow add to cart enabled by the merchant to show a + button.
help.topics.cart-checkout.body2: Your cart is saved on this device for each store.
help.topics.cart-checkout.body3: Checkout uses the payment method the shop connected (e.g. PayPal demo or live payments).
help.topics.saved-places.title: Saved places
help.topics.saved-places.summary: Shops you scan appear under Places for quick return visits.
help.topics.saved-places.body1: Every time you open a store via QR, it is added to Places.
help.topics.saved-places.body2: Use search and sort on the Places tab to find shops in busy markets.
help.topics.saved-places.body3: Tap a shop to open its menu again — no need to rescan if you still have the link.
help.topics.markets-venues.title: Markets & venues
help.topics.markets-venues.summary: Browse multi-shop directories like food halls and markets.
help.topics.markets-venues.body1: On Home, scroll to Markets & venues to explore directories with many shops.
help.topics.markets-venues.body2: Tap a venue to see all tenants and open individual storefronts.
help.topics.markets-venues.body3: Scanning any shop inside still saves it to your Places list.
help.topics.remember-me.title: Remember me & sync
help.topics.remember-me.summary: Bring your saved places to a new phone without a password.
help.topics.remember-me.body1: On Places, enter your email under Sync across devices.
help.topics.remember-me.body2: We email you a one-time link — open it on the new device to restore your list.
help.topics.remember-me.body3: Creating an account also keeps your profile and places tied to you.
help.topics.account-profile.title: Account & profile
help.topics.account-profile.summary: Sign in, edit your profile, and log out.
help.topics.account-profile.body1: Use Account to log in or create a profile with username and photo.
help.topics.account-profile.body2: Guests can browse and shop without an account; sign in to sync across devices.
help.topics.account-profile.body3: Business owners use a separate sign-in and Help center at /business/help.

page.compare.site_builders.title: Zintriq vs site builders
page.compare.site_builders.lead: A site is one possible output (Data + Interface + Publish)—not the product.
page.compare.site_builders.p1.them: Site builders optimize pages and hosting.
page.compare.site_builders.p1.us: Zintriq is five blocks you combine freely.
page.compare.site_builders.p2.us: Same system can compose booking, QR, workflows, and future device/AI outputs.
page.compare.site_builders.p3.us: Data and Logic are first-class, and Publish keeps drafts off the live site.
page.compare.low_code.title: Zintriq vs low-code platforms
page.compare.low_code.lead: Low-code tools add modules per category. Zintriq keeps five blocks, and the category is whatever you build.
page.compare.low_code.p1.them: Module catalog grows with each vertical.
page.compare.low_code.p1.us: The five blocks stay the same; what you combine them into grows.
page.compare.low_code.p2.them: Website app, CRM app, IoT app…
page.compare.low_code.p2.us: No permanent vertical hubs at the conceptual center.
page.compare.low_code.p3.us: Extend with actions, components, and connections on the same model.

page.activate_publish.note: You can edit content anytime, then publish again. Rollback stays available from publish history.

legal.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
legal.cookies.heading: COOKIE POLICY
legal.cookies.s1_p: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the site owners.
legal.cookies.s2_intro: zintriq uses cookies strictly for the following purposes:
legal.cookies.row_necessary_purpose: To keep you logged in, maintain your session state, and prevent security breaches.
legal.cookies.row_necessary_duration: Session (deleted when you close your browser)
legal.cookies.row_pref_purpose: To remember your language preferences and region settings.
legal.cookies.s2_li3: Third-party analytical cookies (we use privacy-first, cookieless analytics)
legal.cookies.s3_p: When you click on payment buttons (PayPal, Stripe, etc.) or review widgets (Trustpilot, Google Reviews, etc.), you are redirected to third-party platforms. These external sites may place their own cookies on your device. zintriq has no access to or control over these third-party cookies. We recommend reviewing the cookie policies of each third-party platform you interact with.
legal.cookies.s4_p: By clicking "Accept" on our cookie banner, or by continuing to use the Platform, you consent to our use of strictly necessary and preference cookies as described above. We do not require consent for essential cookies, but we inform you of their use.
legal.cookies.s5_note: Please note that blocking Strictly Necessary cookies may render the Platform inoperable (you may not be able to log in or use core features).
legal.cookies.s6_p: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated Effective Date.

product.title: Five blocks. Build anything.
product.lead: Most tools are split by category — one for websites, one for bookings, another for devices. Zintriq has five blocks, and the category is whatever you build.
hw.title: Hardware modules that just plug in
hw.lead: Connect a Zintriq module and it appears in the app. Use the same blocks you'd use for a website to make it sense, display and act. No firmware to write.
translate.title: Bring Zintriq to your language
translate.lead: Most of Zintriq's languages are translated by native speakers. Whether your language has a billion speakers or a few hundred, you're welcome here.
home.hero.title: If you can describe it, you can build it.
home.hero.lead: Zintriq is a desktop app for making things. Combine five building blocks — data, interface, logic, connections and publishing — into websites, apps, tools and, soon, hardware. No code required. Code welcome.
home.hero.platforms: Windows, macOS and Linux · Other platforms
home.steps.title: Your first project in three steps
home.steps.1.title: Download and sign in
home.steps.1.body: Free to download. Sign in with your Zintriq account.
home.steps.2.title: Start from a template
home.steps.2.body: Pick something close, then change the words, swap the images and drag in new blocks. Or start blank.
home.steps.3.body.s1: Projects save to your computer automatically. Export one to a single file to back it up or send it to someone.
home.steps.3.title: Publish
home.steps.3.body: Publish in one click and get a link anyone can open. Every release is kept, so you can roll back any time.
home.blocks.title: Everything is made from the same five blocks
home.blocks.lead: A website, a booking system and a device dashboard look different, but they're the same blocks put together differently. Learn one, and you can make the next.
home.blocks.data: **Data**: what you keep track of — products, customers, bookings, files.
home.blocks.interface: **Interface**: what people see and tap — pages, forms, dashboards.
home.blocks.logic: **Logic**: what happens when — like “email me on every new booking.”
home.blocks.connection: **Connections**: links to the outside — payments, email, QR codes, and later, sensors.
home.blocks.publish: **Publish**: put your work in people's hands, with every version kept.
home.make.title: What you can make
home.make.local: Save and export locally, even offline
home.community.title: Don't start from zero
home.community.lead: Zintriq Community is built into the app. Remix templates and projects others have shared into your own version, and share what you make for free.
home.community.note: Open Community from the sidebar in the app. Requires an internet connection.
home.hw.title: Take your work off the screen
home.hw.lead: Zintriq hardware modules show up in the app the moment you plug them in — sensors, buttons, displays, relays. Control them with the same five blocks.
home.anywhere.title: Make it on your computer. Open it anywhere.
home.anywhere.offline: **Works offline**: after you sign in once, keep working without a connection.
home.anywhere.export: **Export any time**: export a project or a whole workspace to a file. Your data stays in your hands.
home.anywhere.sync: **Synced**: projects sync to the cloud, so you can pick up on another computer. Or keep any project local-only.
home.anywhere.publish: **Open on any phone**: published work is a link that opens on phones, tablets and computers, and can be added to the home screen.
home.trust.tracking: **No tracking**: no ad pixels, no third-party trackers.
home.trust.drafts: **Drafts stay private**: unpublished changes never appear on your public link.
home.trust.workspace: **Separate workspaces**: each workspace has its own members and permissions.
home.end.title: Make the thing you're thinking of.
home.end.pricing: Free to download and try. Plans include cloud sync and storage, with no extra fees.

pricing.faq.try.a: Yes. Downloading is free, and you get every feature for {trial_days} days. After that you can still view and export your projects, and subscribing lets you keep editing.
pricing.faq.sync.q: Do I pay extra for cloud sync and storage?

pricing.faq.offline.a: Yes. After you sign in once, you can work offline for up to 30 days. After that you can still view and export, and editing comes back as soon as you reconnect.
pricing.faq.stop.q: What happens to my work if I stop paying?

product.data: **Data**: tables, fields, records, files and how they relate. Import a spreadsheet or connect another source.
product.interface: **Interface**: pages, forms, lists, dashboards and device controls. Drag to build, and preview at desktop, tablet and phone sizes.
product.logic: **Logic**: triggers, conditions and steps. “When someone books, check for a clash, then send a confirmation.”
product.connection: **Connections**: payments, email and SMS, QR codes, outside services — and soon, hardware and AI. Keys stay in connection settings and never ship in published work.
product.publish: **Publish**: each release is a fixed version. Keep editing without touching what's live until you publish again, and roll back whenever you need to.

hw.how.title: How it works
hw.how.1: **Connect**: plug it in over USB. The app recognizes it.
hw.how.2: **Build**: treat sensor readings as data, wire buttons and relays into logic, and make a control panel with the interface block.
hw.how.3: **Flash**: send your program to the module in one click. It keeps running on its own, and you can update it over Wi-Fi.
hw.for.title: Who it's for
hw.for.merchants: **Shops**: queue displays, fridge temperature alerts, check-in buttons — wired straight into your bookings and orders.
hw.for.makers: **Makers**: home automation, plant watering, desk gadgets — without learning circuits and code first.
hw.modules.title: The first modules
hw.open.title: Works with common boards too
hw.open.body: Zintriq builds on the proven ESPHome ecosystem. Common ESP32 boards work too — Zintriq modules just skip the wiring and setup.
hw.mod.climate: **Climate module**: watch a room, a fridge or a greenhouse, and get alerted when it's out of range.
hw.mod.relay: **Relay module**: switch lights, fans or pumps from a button in your interface or on a schedule.
hw.mod.presence: **Presence module**: know when someone's there — turn on lights, count visitors or save power when a space is empty.
hw.wait.done: You're on the list. We'll email {email} when they're available.
hw.wait.already: That email is already on the list.
sec.title: Security & privacy
sec.workspace: **Separate workspaces**: data, members and permissions are kept apart per workspace.
sec.drafts: **Drafts stay private**: public links only show published versions.
sec.ids: **Edits don't break links**: every element keeps a permanent ID, so restyling never breaks bindings or logic.
sec.tracking: **No tracking**: no ad pixels or third-party trackers — only cookieless first-party analytics.
sec.residency: **Data location**: operated from Shanghai, China; stored in Frankfurt, Germany (EU).
sec.signin: **App sign-in**: happens in your browser, so the app never sees your password.
sec.local: **Local first**: projects save to your computer first. Local-only projects are never uploaded.
sec.packages: **Checked Community content**: keys are stripped and links scanned on every share, and content with executable code isn't accepted yet.
about.title: If you can describe it, you can build it.
about.body: We think everyone should be able to make what they need, whether it's software or hardware. Zintriq breaks making things into five blocks, so people who don't code can build complete projects, and people who do can skip the repetitive parts.
